observations.trace: fit derives directions from finite positive-length offsets; if all retained directions coincide with the face vector, the computed axis stays parallel to face, projected face normalizes to none, fallback forward equals face and side becomes the zero cross product. Then the frame cannot separate lateral azimuths. Surface positions and Head center are public; producer normally fits a GPU-read scalp cut from a modified mannequin, and actual generated geometry or accepted reachability has not been demonstrated. Equal-area and seam behavior are not certified by source. Separately, radius sums every position even though the direction set filters invalid offsets; non-finite positions can contaminate texel size if an upstream path supplies them.
observations.future_direction: After audit gate, determine the accepted scalp geometry/finite frame and source guarantees, the appropriate failure policy and ensure CPU texture mapping and native adapter remain coupled. No scalp or fixture was constructed, rendered or measured.

observations.trace: ScalpMap.texel divides by its size parameter, but this selected bake caller passes the private fixed texture side SIZE=2048, so its call is not a zero-size counterexample. A zero-area or non-finite fitted texel size is a different upstream question; cap maps a rejected UV to the default coordinate. The source does not prove those conditions are reachable from ordinary generated scalp data.
observations.future_direction: Review all other texel callers and relevant valid geometry/area policies before claiming a concrete division or rendered artifact.
